method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING-kind, tagged, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (the personal representative's 6 months to commence the action, then the family's permission, s 13(1)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: a member of the deceased person's family who sustained damage because of the death: the person for whose benefit the action is brought (s 8(2)), who may bring it in his or her own name after 6 months (s 13) (cfi-claims.l4)

scope: The whole operative Act, from the family member's seat. In: s 2(2) (deaths before commencement), s 4 (definitions, member of the family, deeming rules), s 5 (application; motor accidents carve-out), s 6 (binds the Crown), s 7 (liability), s 8 (one action, by the personal representative, for the family), s 10 (damages: heads, carer expenses until 18, no-deduction list, the deceased's own settlement, division after costs), s 11 (contributory negligence), s 12 (payment into court), s 13 (action by a member of the family after 6 months; a regulative rule), s 14 (endorsement, in answers), s 15(1), (2) (omitted names; separate representation), s 16 (jury, in comments). Out: s 1, s 2(1), s 15(3), (4) (machinery); the time limit for the action (s 9 repealed; Limitation Act 1981 (NT)); the Motor Accidents (Compensation) Act 1979 and the Law Reform (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1956 (asked as facts). Reasons in NOTES.md.
also_reads: subjects/au/nt/limitation-act-1981 (the time limit for the action, since s 9 of this Act was repealed by the Limitation Act 1981)
subjects/au/nt/law-reform-miscellaneous-provisions-act-1956 (s 11: contributory negligence; Part II survival of actions for the estate)
